question_ar: أنا المفروض بالمستوى السادس حسب خطتي. هل أنا ماشي معها ولا متأخر عن دفعتي؟
detail: why_answerable claims "build_unlock_report يحمل programme_term لكل مقرر في الخطة ضمن حقل term، وmy_progress/graduation_progress يقارنان حالة المقرر بموقعه في الخطة". False at the executor boundary. build_unlock_report does hold `term` internally (student_unlock.py, info[code]["term"]), but _exec_my_progress (virtual_advisor_capabilities.py:806-838) emits open_now rows as {code,name,credits,fits_this_term}, blocked rows as {code,name,steps_away,opens_n_courses,nearest_course_you_can_take_now,why}, and elective_slots as bare codes — `term` is stripped from every row. _exec_graduation_progress (:918-938) emits no per-course rows at all. Neither of the two named capabilities lets the model say which remaining courses sit at programme_term <= 6, so the answer sketch ("هذه هي المقررات المتأخرة عن ترتيب الخطة وهي (الرموز)") cannot be produced without fabrication.
fix: Add get_student_context to capabilities — _compact_course_rows (virtual_advisor.py:194-209) does return programme_term on every course_evidence.remaining_requirements row, which is the only surface that carries it. Or add "term" to the my_progress row projection.

question_ar: المواد اللي طلعها لي النظام كتوصية للترم الجاي، تأكد لي منها وحدة وحدة: فيه شي منها مقفل علي بمتطلب ولا كلها فاتحة؟
detail: recommend_courses and why_course_locked do not share a course universe, so the per-course verification the question demands breaks on real students. Executed against the live DB at 1448/1: student 4152911 (IS) gets recommendations ['IS411','CS211','IS383']; why_course_locked returns ok:False, error "IS411 is not in this student's degree plan." (_exec_why_course_locked falls through all five buckets and errors, :898). This is by design — _exec_recommend_courses comments that "Resolved electives can land outside this programme's plan", while build_unlock_report only ever classifies ProgrammeRequirement rows. The honest response for that row is exactly the string must_not_contain forbids ("لا أستطيع التحقق"), so a correct answer is graded as a failure.
fix: Either restrict the question to a pinned student whose recommendation list is entirely inside ProgrammeRequirement, or drop "لا أستطيع التحقق" from must_not_contain and require the answer to name the elective-resolved code as unverifiable by that tool.

question_ar: أنا متوقع تخرجي هالفصل، كم ساعة يسمحون لي أسجلها؟
detail: must_contain requires "16", but 16 reaches the model only through credit_policy_evidence's `qualification` block, which is emitted solely when status == 'GRADUATION EXPECTED' AND term in {1,2} (credit_policy.py:120). The question binds no student. Live counts: 391 of 3194 students carry that status; for the other 2803 the tool emits regulatory_min 12 / regulatory_max 19 and no 16 at all, and the correct answer would then fail must_contain. The staff twin in this same batch does it right — it pins 3456782, which I confirmed is status='GRADUATION EXPECTED', program CS, section F.
fix: Pin a student_id with status='GRADUATION EXPECTED' (e.g. 3456782), exactly as the staff-voiced sibling question does, or demote to EXPLAIN_ONLY and drop the FULL claim.

question_ar: عندي تقدير (ل) غير مكتمل من الفصل الثاني ١٤٤٧. متى آخر موعد أقدر أعدّله فيه؟ وإذا ما عدلته وش يصير عليه؟ وهل هو داخل في معدلي الحين؟
detail: Marked FULL with capabilities: [] — nothing student-specific is read, yet the question asserts a per-student fact ("عندي تقدير (ل)") and then asks a per-student question ("هل هو داخل في معدلي الحين؟"). Grade symbols are the canonical absent class: TU.LOAD.INCOMPLETE_GRADE's own notes record StudentCourse.grade empty on all 159,778 rows, and it adds that "الفصل التالي" is unresolvable because actual_term is empty on every row. A FULL label here invites the model to confirm the premise and report on the student's own GPA composition — the fabrication-graded-as-success case. Separately, the only load-bearing date record, TU.CAL.1448T1.9D3426DFD4, appears in why_answerable but not in policy_ids.
fix: Set answer_mode: EXPLAIN_ONLY and add TU.CAL.1448T1.9D3426DFD4 to policy_ids. Reword the opening so the (ل) is stated by the student as an assumption the adviser cannot verify.

question_ar: متى آخر موعد لطلب معادلة المقررات؟ ضروري أعرف لأن خطتي كلها تتغير عليه.
detail: Marked FULL with capabilities: ["get_student_context"], but the answer sketch contains no student-derived fact whatsoever — it is the single date from TU.CAL.1448T1.5B1D641422 (DEADLINE_ONLY, ends.iso 2026-12-02) plus the deadline_only_note caveat. get_student_context contributes nothing that appears in the sketch, must_contain, or must_not_contain. Labelling a pure-calendar answer FULL corrupts the very statistic this batch exists to move (FULL vs abstain), and leaves the grader expecting personalisation the question does not admit.
fix: Set answer_mode: EXPLAIN_ONLY and remove get_student_context — or make it genuinely FULL by asking something like "وهل فيه في خطتي مقررات معادَلة أصلاً؟", which get_student_context can answer from passed/remaining requirements.

question_ar: الترم متى يبدأ بالضبط؟ وأول محاضرة عندي في أي يوم ووين مكانها؟
detail: The two halves come from different terms and the sketch silently welds them. Term start 2026-08-23 is TU.CAL.1448T1.0BBCD43E7C, i.e. 1448 term 1. my_timetable returns 1447 term 2: every StudentTermSection row in the DB is ('1447','2') (verified: single distinct pair over 18,468 rows), and _exec_my_timetable's empty-result fallback resolves to exactly that pair. So "أول محاضرة عندي" in the term that starts 23 August is not knowable, and this batch's own sibling question ("الجدول اللي تعرضه لي هذا لأي سنة وأي فصل") exists precisely to forbid this conflation. The sketch also instructs the model to report "المحاضر كما هي في النظام" — instructor is the empty string on all 1668 published TermSectionMeeting rows (verified: 0 non-empty), which the IS482 question in the same batch handles correctly and this one does not.
fix: Split into two questions, or keep one and require the answer to state that the published timetable is 1447 T2 while the quoted start date is 1448 T1. Delete "والمحاضر" from the sketch and add an instructor-fabrication token to must_not_contain.

question_ar: عندنا لقاء إرشاد الأسبوع الجاي. المرشد 43 — مين من طلابه معدله تحت 2؟ وهل أقدر أعتبرهم على إنذار أكاديمي وأكلمهم على هالأساس؟
detail: The counts are right (list_students_by_advisor('43') → count 22, summary.low_gpa_count 2, focus='risk' → 2 items) but the gold answer asserts something the schema contradicts for exactly those two students. Live: advisor 43's sub-2.0 students are 4079929 (gpa 1.98) and 4080183 (gpa 1.98), and BOTH carry Student.status = 'ACTIVE WITH ACADEMIC WARNING 1'. find_students_tool returns `status` in every row (virtual_advisor.py:432-439), so the model can see it. The sketch's "سجل الإنذارات غير موجود في قاعدة البيانات إطلاقاً — فلا يمكن لأحد أن يقول كم إنذاراً على أي طالب" is therefore false, and must_not_contain ["حصل على إنذار","لديه إنذاران"] penalises the accurate answer. (TU.DISMISSAL.THREE_WARNINGS' own runtime_use_reason makes the same overstatement — it cites 'FAIL IN LAST TERM' and misses the two ACADEMIC WARNING 1/2 status values, which cover 7 students.)
fix: Rewrite the gold answer to the true distinction: Student.status records a warning STATE for some students but no consecutive COUNT and no ordering (actual_term empty on all rows), so the three-warning dismissal test still cannot be evaluated. Replace the must_not_contain guards with ones that forbid asserting a count (e.g. "ثلاثة إنذارات", "مفصول") rather than forbidding the word إنذار.

question_ar: خطتي تقول ما باقي لي إلا مقررين، يعني أنا صرت خريج ولا لسه؟
detail: must_contain includes the seven-word diacritised phrase "لا يُعد الطالب متخرجاً" and the tanween form "متبقٍ". A model writing natural Arabic will produce "لا يعتبر الطالب متخرجاً" / "لا يعد الطالب متخرجا" / "المتبقي" — none of which contain those substrings. The source itself uses a different wording (TU.GRADUATION.COUNCIL_AWARDS_DEGREE: "لا يعتبر الطالب متخرجاً إلا بعد صدور موافقة مجلس الجامعة"). The question is therefore near-certain to fail regardless of answer quality, which makes the whole item non-discriminating. "متبقٍ" has the same defect in the "أنا المفروض بالمستوى السادس" question.
fix: Replace with undiacritised, short, discriminating tokens: ["مجلس الجامعة","متخرج","موافقة"]. Never put a harakat-bearing form in must_contain.

question_ar: وش عندي بكرة الأحد؟
detail: must_contain is ["الأحد"] — a single token that the question itself supplies. Any answer that echoes the day passes, including a wholly invented Sunday timetable; the point of the item (that my_timetable returns real day/start/end/room rows from TermSectionMeeting) is not tested at all. must_not_contain only blocks building numbers and seat counts, neither of which a fabricating model would volunteer.
fix: Pin a student and put two verifiable values in must_contain — a real start time and a real room code from that student's SUN meetings (e.g. "09:00" and "172FB004" for a CS112/M42 student, verified in the DB).

question_ar: كم الفراغ بالضبط بين محاضراتي يوم الثلاثاء؟ أبيه بالدقيقة مو تقريب.
detail: Same defect as the Sunday item: must_contain ["الثلاثاء","دقيقة"] contains no computed value, so a fabricated gap ("بينهما 45 دقيقة") scores identically to the correct arithmetic over my_timetable's start/end strings. The question explicitly demands exactness ("بالدقيقة مو تقريب") and then grades nothing exact.
fix: Pin a student whose TUE meetings are known and require the actual gap in minutes plus one bounding time, e.g. must_contain ["الثلاثاء","دقيقة","09:00"] with the computed figure.

question_ar: جدولي ما فيه أسماء الدكاترة أصلاً — متى ينتهي إسناد الشعب لأعضاء هيئة التدريس؟
detail: must_contain requires the literal "26-أغسطس-2026". That hyphenated form exists only inside the YAML (TU.CAL.1448T1.51A74F7949 ends.gregorian); a model answering in Arabic prose will write "26 أغسطس 2026", which does not contain the substring. The item will fail on correct answers. Second defect in the same question: policy_ids is [] even though the required date comes solely from TU.CAL.1448T1.51A74F7949 — the grader has no cited record to check. (The staff-voiced twin cites it correctly and uses the safe tokens ["آخر موعد","أغسطس","1448"].)
fix: Set policy_ids: ["TU.CAL.1448T1.51A74F7949"] and change must_contain to ["آخر موعد","26","أغسطس","2026"]. The empty-instructor half is sound — instructor is '' on all 1668 published meetings, verified.

question_ar: الجدول اللي تعرضه لي هذا لأي سنة وأي فصل بالضبط؟
detail: The whole point of the item is to stop the model importing 1448-T1 calendar dates into a 1447-T2 timetable answer, but must_not_contain lists only the hyphenated YAML forms ["23-أغسطس-2026","20-أغسطس-2026","07-يناير-2027"]. A model that commits exactly the error under test will write "بداية الدراسة 23 أغسطس 2026" in prose and sail past every guard. The guard blocks a string the model would never emit and permits the string it actually emits.
fix: Guard the semantic instead: must_not_contain ["1448","بداية الدراسة","الاختبارات النهائية"], keeping must_contain ["1447"]. Verified sound otherwise: _exec_my_timetable echoes academic_year/term, and the only published pair in StudentTermSection is ('1447','2').

question_ar: طفشت صراحة… المرشد قال لي اعتذر عن الترم، وأمي تقول أجّل، وواحد من دفعتي يقول لا انسحب من المواد وخلاص. أنا ضايع بين الثلاثة، وش الفرق بالضبط وأيهم يأخر تخرجي؟
detail: Duplicates the existing 200 rather than counterweighting them. evals/advisor/questions.yaml Q62 is "وش الفرق بين الاعتذار والتأجيل؟" and Q70 is "هل الاعتذار يؤخر موعد تخرجي؟" — this item is those two concatenated, resolved by the same records (TU.LEAVE.COMPARISON, TU.EXCUSE.COUNTS_TOWARD_DURATION, TU.DEFERRAL.NOT_COUNTED). TU.LEAVE.COMPARISON's own notes even name Q34/Q62 as the questions it answers. It adds only the third column, which the comparison record already carries as `course_withdrawal: not_stated`.
fix: Either drop it, or pivot it onto what the existing pair does NOT ask: the withdrawal column is not_stated on the graduation clock, so make the question turn on the adviser correctly refusing to fill that cell while answering the other two.

question_ar: أبي أأجل الفصل الثاني مو الأول، متى ينتهي تقديم طلب التأجيل؟
detail: Same question, same record, same date as "خلاص قررت أكمّل هالترم بس أبي أأجل الترم الثاني — متى آخر يوم أقدّم فيه طلب التأجيل، وهل فيه فترة تبدأ منها؟" elsewhere in this batch. Both resolve to TU.DEFERRAL.PROCEDURE + TU.CAL.1448T1.2FD02E8B5F (DEADLINE_ONLY, 2026-12-02), both are EXPLAIN_ONLY, and their must_contain sets are ["ديسمبر","آخر موعد","الفصل الثاني"] vs ["آخر موعد","ديسمبر","2026","الفصل الثاني"]. The batch already contains a third deferral item ("أبي أأجل الدراسة، متى آخر موعد للتقديم؟") that tests the genuinely distinct thing — the two-branch ambiguity.
fix: Keep the ambiguous one and the disambiguated one; delete this third copy. If a slot is needed in rules-leave-withdrawal, use the term-1 branch instead (TU.CAL.1448T1.3B082D1A26, 2026-08-15), which no item currently tests alone.

question_ar: متى آخر موعد للاعتذار عن الفصل الأول 1448؟
detail: Identical in record, date and mode to "ظروفي صعبة هالترم وأفكر أعتذر عن الفصل كامل — لين متى أقدر أقدّم الطلب في الفصل الأول 1448؟" in the calendar-dates slice. Both cite TU.EXCUSE.PROCEDURE bound to TU.CAL.1448T1.C6FAD43E10 (DEADLINE_ONLY, 2026-10-28), both EXPLAIN_ONLY, must_contain ["آخر موعد","28","أكتوبر"] vs ["آخر موعد","28","أكتوبر","2026"], and both must_not_contain the same "الفترة من". The only difference is register.
fix: Keep one. Replace the other with an excuse question the store answers differently — e.g. the (ع) transcript mark and its p24/p29 collision, or the stipend consequence, neither of which is duplicated in this slice.

question_ar: المرشد قال لي إن التعديل على التسجيل يقفل قبل بداية الدراسة بأسبوع، واكتشفت متأخر إن مادة سجلتها متطلبها ناقص. متى فعلياً آخر يوم أعدل فيه للفصل الأول 1448؟
detail: Same conflict, same two calendar rows, same student voice as "أنا محتار صراحة — في الدليل الإرشادي مكتوب إن كافة إجراءات التسجيل تنتهي قبل بدء الدراسة بأسبوع..." in calendar-dates. Both are EXPLAIN_ONLY on CONFLICT.ADD_DROP_DEADLINE, both must produce 20/22/23 August 2026 from TU.CAL.1448T1.E92DB8DA87 + TU.CAL.1448T1.0BBCD43E7C. This one is the weaker of the two: it omits CONFLICT.ADD_DROP_DEADLINE from policy_ids (the record that actually resolves it, in sources.yaml) and its capabilities [course_prerequisites, why_course_locked] are decorative — the missing-prerequisite clause never enters the answer sketch. The staff-voiced third copy is defensible since it tests a different audience.
fix: Delete this one and keep the calendar-dates version, which cites the conflict record. If the prerequisite angle is wanted, make it load-bearing: ask which specific course is blocked and require why_course_locked's blocked_by in must_contain.

question_ar: متى أقدر أسجل رغباتي للترم الثاني عشان أرتب خطتي من بدري؟
detail: Byte-for-byte the same evidence as "متى يفتح تسجيل الرغبات للفصل الثاني؟ وياليت تعطيني المواد اللي المفروض أحطها." in calendar-dates: identical policy_ids [TU.REG.EARLY_REGISTRATION_TIMING, TU.CAL.1448T1.9FFEF452C7], identical capabilities {my_progress, recommend_courses}, identical answer_mode FULL, and must_contain ["11","15","أكتوبر"] which is a strict subset of the other's ["11","15","أكتوبر","2026","الفصل الثاني"]. Nothing distinguishes them but phrasing.
fix: Keep the calendar-dates version (tighter must_contain, and its second clause makes recommend_courses load-bearing). Replace this plan-progress slot with the one early-registration milestone that has no calendar row — TU.REG.EARLY_REGISTRATION_TIMING's ADVISER_REVIEW / FINAL_REGISTRATION, which the record itself marks PARTIALLY_EVALUABLE.

question_ar: عندنا لقاء إرشاد الأسبوع الجاي. المرشد 43 — مين من طلابه معدله تحت 2؟ وهل أقدر أعتبرهم على إنذار أكاديمي وأكلمهم على هالأساس؟
detail: The tool numbers are right (list_students_by_advisor('43', focus='risk') → count=22, low_gpa_count=2, shown_count=2, verified). The POLICY claim is not. The sketch asserts «سجل الإنذارات غير موجود في قاعدة البيانات إطلاقاً — فلا يمكن لأحد أن يقول كم إنذاراً على أي طالب». students.status actually carries 'ACTIVE WITH ACADEMIC WARNING 1' (4 rows), 'ACTIVE WITH ACADEMIC WARNING 2' (3 rows) and 'DISMISSED - ACADEMIC WARNING' (2 rows). So a per-student warning LEVEL does exist for 9 students. Worse, must_not_contain bans «لديه إنذاران» — for a student whose status literally reads WARNING 2 that ban fails a correct answer. The cited record TU.DISMISSAL.THREE_WARNINGS repeats the same error in its runtime_use_reason («Student.status carries outcomes such as 'FAIL IN LAST TERM' (18 students), never a counter»), so the question inherited a defect rather than introducing one.
fix: Correct both the record and the item. The defensible claim is narrower and still wins the argument: status carries a CURRENT warning level for a handful of students but no consecutive-warning HISTORY and no event ordering (actual_term empty on all rows), so «ثلاثة إنذارات متتالية» remains uncomputable. Replace the banned token «لديه إنذاران» with the actual fabrication class: «تقديم gpa<2.0 أو تصنيف focus='risk' على أنه إنذار أكاديمي».

question_ar: وش أكثر المقررات طلباً في AI للترم القادم؟ ولا تعطيني شي ما نقدر نفتح له شعبة باسمه.
detail: must_contain hard-codes AI1=178 and CS424=152. Those are the values of build_aggregate_counts(1448, 1, program='AI') — I reproduced them exactly. But _exec_aggregate_demand takes year/term from the chat ctx (_ctx_year_term, line 240) with NO default; every student_term_sections row in the DB is ('1447','2'), and at (1447,2) the same call returns FE1=35, AI212=35, AI342=22 — none of the required tokens appear. The item is gradeable only if the harness pins academic_year=1448, term=1, and nothing in the item says so. Same defect in the twin: «شطر الطالبات في CS: أبي أعلى ثلاثة مقررات طلباً» (MATH320=306/STAT301=263/CS323=257 are 1448/1 values; at 1447/2 the top three are BIOL101=60, ENGL214=55, CS3=54).
fix: Either add an explicit fixture line to both items («ctx: academic_year=1448, term=1») and state it in why_answerable, or make the Arabic name the term («للفصل الأول 1448») so the model is expected to pass academic_year/term itself — and then keep the integers.

question_ar: الترم متى يبدأ بالضبط؟ وأول محاضرة عندي في أي يوم ووين مكانها؟
detail: The answer_sketch instructs the reference answer to give «الأيام والأوقات التالية مع القاعة والمحاضر كما هي في النظام». There is no المحاضر. I checked: across the 1,668 published meetings (scraper_timetable 1,532 + external 136 — and student_term_sections links to those two tags only) instructor is empty on every single row; the 1,113 non-empty instructor rows all belong to tw_auto/tw_scheduler sections no student is linked to. Another item in this same batch («جدولي ما فيه أسماء الدكاترة أصلاً») states this correctly. So this sketch invites exactly the fabrication the set exists to catch, and must_not_contain («سبتمبر», «المبنى الرئيسي») has no instructor guard.
fix: Drop «والمحاضر» from the sketch and add «أي اسم لعضو هيئة تدريس» to must_not_contain. Same guard is missing from «وش عندي بكرة الأحد؟» and «المقررات اللي أنا مسجلها هالترم» — add it there too.

question_ar: مادتي فيها ٣٠ محاضرة في الترم وأنا غايب ٦ محاضرات. كم باقي لي قبل ما ينزل علي حرمان؟ ولو انحرمت أقدر أواصل حضور وأدخل النهائي؟
detail: why_answerable argues the item is answerable because «الطالب زوّد بنفسه العددين المطلوبين في required_inputs». That exemption is invented. TU.GPA.FORMULA was deliberately marked runtime_use: PERMITTED_WITH_USER_PROVIDED_INPUTS; TU.ATTENDANCE.DEPRIVATION_THRESHOLD is marked runtime_use: PROHIBITED_FOR_DECISION with reason «Both required inputs are MISSING. The rule is fully explainable and never applicable.» The item then issues an actionable safety verdict — «أمامك غياباً واحداً آمناً» — off a record the project marked never-applicable. If a student's real lecture count differs from 30, that sentence sends them into deprivation.
fix: Two clean options: (a) amend the attendance record to carry the same PERMITTED_WITH_USER_PROVIDED_INPUTS marker as the GPA record, which is the consistent reading — then this item is fine; or (b) keep the arithmetic but delete the verdict, ending at «٧ غيابات = 23.3% و٨ = 26.7%، والحساب على رقمك أنت». Do not ship it citing PROHIBITED_FOR_DECISION as if it permitted the call.

question_ar: GS103 عندي أونلاين وبعدها بنفس اليوم عندي محاضرة في المبنى، ألحق ولا لأ؟
detail: This is existing item 159 verbatim in substance: «عندي محاضرة عن بُعد وبعدها حضوري مباشرة.» Item 159 is currently graded answer_mode PARTIAL with must_abstain: true. Shipping both means the set contains the same ask twice with opposite verdicts on whether abstaining is correct — a judge cannot be consistent across them, and the 51%-by-refusing baseline this batch exists to break is exactly what 159 rewards.
fix: Don't add a second copy — fix 159. Flip 159 to FULL/must_abstain:false with the GS103 evidence (all 9 GS103 sections room='Blackboard', building='أونلاين', verified) and let the counterweight come from re-grading, not from a near-identical new row.

question_ar: عندي تقرير طبي من مركز صحي حكومي مو من منصة صحة، ومر عليه ثلاثة أسابيع من يوم إصداره. أرفعه لمين؟ وهل ينفع أصلاً؟
detail: Two existing items concatenated, with one noun swapped. Existing 198 «عندي تقرير طبي من مستشفى خاص، هل يُقبل؟» is the same ask (issuer not on the accepted list → state منصة صحة / الإدارة الطبية / المستشفى الجامعي); TU.MEDICAL_EXCUSE.ACCEPTED_ISSUERS even says so in its own notes field: «Answers Q198 by exclusion». Existing 199 «فاتني موعد تقديم العذر، وش أسوي؟» is the second half, and TU.MEDICAL_EXCUSE.SUBMISSION_WINDOW's notes say «Answers Q199». Changing مستشفى خاص → مركز صحي حكومي adds no new discrimination.
fix: Cut it. If you want the medical-excuse topic represented in the answerable set, target what 198/199 do NOT reach: TU.MEDICAL_EXCUSE.EFFECT_ON_ASSESSMENTS's undefined «الضوابط المحددة» — which the batch already covers well in the hospitalisation-during-finals item. Keep that one, drop this.

question_ar: أبي أعرف كم ساعة باقية لي على التخرج، وكم ساعة مسموح لي أسجلها الترم الجاي؟
detail: Clause 1 is existing item 91 word-for-word («كم ساعة باقي لي على التخرج؟», already FULL, already graded on graduation_progress). Clause 2 is existing items 5 and 6 («كم ساعة تنصحني أسجل هذا الترم؟» / «أقدر أسجل ساعات أكثر من الحد المسموح؟»), and expected.yaml id 1 already carries the identical 12/19-vs-18 must_contain and the identical «18 بوصفه الحد الأعلى» ban. Nothing here is new; it is three existing asks stapled together.
fix: Cut it. The 12/19/18 distinction is already better tested by the new «أنا متوقع تخرجي هالفصل، كم ساعة يسمحون لي أسجلها؟», which is the only item that reaches the unresolved 16-vs-19 open_question — keep that one.

question_ar: متى آخر موعد للاعتذار عن الفصل الأول 1448؟
detail: Identical twin inside this batch: «ظروفي صعبة هالترم وأفكر أعتذر عن الفصل كامل — لين متى أقدر أقدّم الطلب في الفصل الأول 1448؟». Same policy_ids (TU.EXCUSE.PROCEDURE), same calendar row TU.CAL.1448T1.C6FAD43E10, same must_contain (آخر موعد / 28 / أكتوبر), same DEADLINE_ONLY guard in must_not_contain, same sketch. One is the other with a sentence of preamble.
fix: Keep the conversational one (the preamble is what makes the register varied) and delete the bare one. If you want two excuse items, make the second one bite on something else — e.g. that TU.EXCUSE.PROCEDURE's calendar row is scoped «للنظام الفصلي» and says nothing about النظام السنوي.

question_ar: خلاص قررت أكمّل هالترم بس أبي أأجل الترم الثاني — متى آخر يوم أقدّم فيه طلب التأجيل، وهل فيه فترة تبدأ منها؟
detail: Third copy of one ask. The batch contains: this, «أبي أأجل الفصل الثاني مو الأول، متى ينتهي تقديم طلب التأجيل؟», and «أبي أأجل الدراسة، متى آخر موعد للتقديم؟». All three resolve TU.DEFERRAL.PROCEDURE against TU.CAL.1448T1.2FD02E8B5F (2026-12-02) and all three must state the DEADLINE_ONLY caveat. The third one strictly subsumes the other two, since it forces the model to surface BOTH dates (15 أغسطس for term 1, 2 ديسمبر for term 2) and disambiguate — which is the actual skill.
fix: Keep only «أبي أأجل الدراسة، متى آخر موعد للتقديم؟». Delete both term-2 variants.

question_ar: متى ينتهي إسناد شعب المقررات آلياً لأعضاء هيئة التدريس؟ القسم يبي يرتّب نفسه قبلها.
detail: Same single calendar row (TU.CAL.1448T1.51A74F7949, DEADLINE_ONLY, 2026-08-26) and same DEADLINE_ONLY guard as the timetable-slice item «جدولي ما فيه أسماء الدكاترة أصلاً — متى ينتهي إسناد الشعب لأعضاء هيئة التدريس؟». The staff version's entire content is that one row; capabilities is [] so it exercises nothing the student version doesn't.
fix: Delete this one; the student-framed twin is strictly richer (it also forces the empty-instructor fact, which is verified: 0 non-empty instructor rows in 1,668 published meetings). If the staff slice needs a calendar item, use TU.CAL.1448T1.F0F5B86EF4 (إنشاء الشعب, FULL_WINDOW 25 أكتوبر–5 نوفمبر) — but note it is already carried by the CS-female-demand item.

question_ar: المرشد قال لي إن التعديل على التسجيل يقفل قبل بداية الدراسة بأسبوع، واكتشفت متأخر إن مادة سجلتها متطلبها ناقص. متى فعلياً آخر يوم أعدل فيه للفصل الأول 1448؟
detail: Fourth item in the batch grading on the same three dates. The others: «أنا محتار صراحة — في الدليل الإرشادي مكتوب إن كافة إجراءات التسجيل تنتهي قبل بدء الدراسة بأسبوع» (calendar slice), «الطلاب يسألوني عن إغلاق التعديلات» (staff slice), and «الحذف والإضافة على بوابة الطالب... يفتح متى بالضبط؟» (calendar slice). All four end at 20–22 أغسطس + بداية الدراسة 23 أغسطس, and three of them resolve CONFLICT.ADD_DROP_DEADLINE identically. This one is also mis-filed: it sits in slice prereq-blocking and opens with a missing-prerequisite hook that the answer never addresses.
fix: Cut this one outright. Of the remaining three, keep at most two: the plain-window question (no conflict) and ONE conflict question. The staff-framed conflict version is the better keeper because it adds authority_precedence and the «what do I tell students» duty; drop the student-framed conflict twin.

question_ar: المواد اللي أنا مسجلها هالترم كم مجموع ساعاتها؟ ولو فرضنا جبت ٩٠٪ في كل وحدة منها، كم بيطلع معدلي الفصلي من ٥؟
detail: Same graded content as «خلصت مادتين هالترم: ٩٣٪ في مادة ٣ ساعات و٧٨٪ في مادة ساعتين» — both grade on the TU.GRADE.SCALE band lookup plus TU.GPA.FORMULA. And the computation here is degenerate: the item's own sketch admits «المعدل الفصلي يساوي 4.75 مهما كان توزيع الساعات», so the get_student_context retrieval of credit hours is decorative and the only scoring token, 4.75, is shared with the twin.
fix: Either cut it, or make the hours load-bearing: give two different assumed marks («٩٠٪ في الإجبارية و٧٠٪ في الحرة») so the credit-hour weighting actually changes the answer and the retrieval is genuinely required.

question_ar: عندي يوم الاثنين محاضرتين ورا بعض في PHYS104 شعبة M28، والقاعتين مو بنفس المكان. كم عندي وقت بينهم؟
detail: Same shape as «في CS323 شعبة F8 يوم الأربعاء عندي المحاضرة وبعدها العملي على طول، وين كل وحدة؟» — two same-day meetings, two different rooms, a 5-minute gap, answer = read both rows and subtract. I verified both (PHYS104/M28 MON 11:40–12:55 @125GA007 then 13:00–14:40 @128GC005; CS323/F8 WED 15:50–17:05 @239FC001 then 17:10–18:50 @204SCL002) — the data is right, but it's one template instantiated twice. The batch also carries a third, generic version («كم الفراغ بالضبط بين محاضراتي يوم الثلاثاء؟»).
fix: Keep the CS323 one (lecture-then-lab is the harder read, and it also carries a third meeting on a different day) plus the generic Tuesday one. Drop PHYS104 — or repurpose it into the ask no item currently covers: a section whose meetings sit in two different BUILDINGS (315 published sections have more than one room; 128 vs 125 here) versus the 315-section room-change fact.

question_ar: أنا AI في المستوى السادس ومفكر أأجل AI331 ترم واحد لأنها ثقيلة مع الباقي، هل تأجيلها يأخر تخرجي فعلياً ولا عادي؟
detail: The sketch says «يعتمد عليها مباشرة AI352 وAI491». In programme AI, AI331 has FIVE direct dependants, not two: AI352, AI371, AI433, AI482, AI491 (verified against the prerequisites table). must_contain locks only AI352/AI491, so a model that under-reports the blast radius scores the same as one that gets it right — and the reference answer itself teaches the under-report. Compare the CS111 item in the same slice, which correctly states three direct children and a 15-course transitive closure (both verified).
fix: Change the sketch to name all five (or write «يعتمد عليها مباشرة خمسة مقررات، منها…») and add AI433 or AI482 to must_contain so the count is actually graded.

question_ar: متى الفاينل؟
detail: must_not_contain is ['فترة واحدة','الفصل الثاني']. «فترة واحدة» is a literal string a model would almost never emit — the real failure mode is silently giving ONE window (answering «من 20 إلى 24 ديسمبر» and stopping) or assigning التخصصية to the general-courses window. Neither is caught. The grading contract in expected.yaml explicitly says must_not_contain entries are PATTERNS judged by a judge, so a class description is available and should be used here.
fix: Replace with the fabrication classes: «تقديم فترة اختبارات نهائية واحدة تغطي كل المقررات» and «إسناد المقررات التخصصية أو الحرة إلى فترة 20–24 ديسمبر». Keep «الفصل الثاني» as the scope guard.

question_ar: وش عندي بكرة الأحد؟
detail: Two problems. (1) The guards ('مبنى رقم','عدد المقاعد','المقاعد المتبقية') miss the likeliest inventions for a timetable read: an instructor name (empty on all 1,668 published meetings) and a course the student is not actually registered in. (2) «بكرة» is asserted to be الأحد with no anchor. If the eval is replayed on any day other than Saturday the question contradicts itself, and a model that correctly says «بكرة هو الاثنين» would be graded wrong against must_contain ['الأحد'].
fix: Anchor the day («وش عندي يوم الأحد؟» or pin a fixture date in the item), and add «اسم محاضر» + «مقرر غير مسجَّل للطالب» to must_not_contain.

question_ar: متى آخر موعد لطلب معادلة المقررات؟ ضروري أعرف لأن خطتي كلها تتغير عليه.
detail: must_contain is ['آخر موعد','ديسمبر','2026'] — that does not identify the event. 2026-12-02 is the closing date of FOUR separate calendar rows: معادلة المقررات (5B1D641422), تأجيل الفصل الثاني (2FD02E8B5F), الانسحاب النهائي من الجامعة (A1AB283A0A), and تعديل الدرجة/غير مكتمل (9D3426DFD4). An answer that confidently cites the wrong one of the four passes every token. The same collision weakens the (ل) item and the final-withdrawal item, which share the date.
fix: Add the discriminating day number ('2') AND the event name token ('معادلة') to must_contain across all four items, and add a must_not_contain entry «نسبة التاريخ إلى إجراء آخر مغلق في 2 ديسمبر» so quoting the right date for the wrong procedure is caught.

question_ar: خطتي تقول ما باقي لي إلا مقررين، يعني أنا صرت خريج ولا لسه؟
detail: Good item — the ACADEMIC_PLAN_COMPLETE vs OFFICIAL_GRADUATION_ELIGIBILITY split is exactly what the set needs. But must_contain carries the full sentence «لا يُعد الطالب متخرجاً», and expected.yaml's own grading contract says must_contain entries are literal substrings and must be «a number, a course code, an Arabic term, never a sentence». Any correct paraphrase («لا تُعد متخرجاً» / «لا يُعتبر الطالب خريجاً») fails. This is set-wide: «ليس متطلباً مقرراً», «رقمان مختلفان», «لا تحتسب», «الفصل النهائي», «المكان والزمان» have the same brittleness.
fix: Sweep every must_contain in the batch for multi-word phrases and reduce each to its discriminating token — here «مجلس الجامعة» (already present) plus «متبقٍ» is sufficient; move the sentence into answer_sketch_ar where it belongs.

question_ar: قبل ما المرشد يعتمد تسجيلي، المفروض يتأكد من إيش بخصوص جدولي بالذات؟
detail: Declares capabilities: ['my_timetable'] but the answer is 100% policy text from TU.REG.ADVISER_DUTIES_AT_REGISTRATION and TU.REG.STUDENT_CHOICES_FINAL; no tool output is needed, produced, or graded. That inflates the batch's apparent capability coverage — the item is really a rules item filed in the timetable slice. (Same pattern, milder: «متى آخر موعد لطلب معادلة المقررات» declares get_student_context and uses none of it.)
fix: Either set capabilities: [] and move it to a rules slice, or make it genuinely FULL by having it check the student's OWN board for a clash: «هل في جدولي المسجَّل تعارض؟» — which my_timetable can answer from the day/start/end rows and which no item in the batch currently asks.

question_ar: جاني الإنذار الثالث ورا بعض. يعني انفصلت خلاص ولا فيه شي ممكن يوقف الفصل؟
detail: Same rule as existing item 46 «كم إنذار أكاديمي ممكن آخذ قبل الفصل؟», which is already EXPLAIN_ONLY with must_abstain: false — i.e. already in the answerable half, so it is not the abstain-heavy dead weight this batch is meant to counterweight. The only increment is the UNIVERSITY_COUNCIL additional-chance exception.
fix: Keep it only if you narrow the ask to the increment («سمعت إن فيه فرصة إضافية من المجلس — صحيح؟») so it is not scored on the three-warnings rule that 46 already scores. Otherwise fold the exception into item 46's expectation and cut this.
